from pathlib import Path
program_dir = Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-seq0/frozen/seen/play/users/u063/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
program_path = program_dir / 'task-22825a64.py'
source = '''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    colors = {value for row in grid for value in row}
    line_colors = [c for c in colors if any(all(x == c for x in row) for row in grid) or any(all(grid[r][col] == c for r in range(h)) for col in range(w))]
    target = line_colors[0] if line_colors else min(colors, key=lambda c: sum(row.count(c) for row in grid))
    return [[2 if value == target else value for value in row] for row in grid]
'''
program_path.write_text(source)
exec(compile(source, str(program_path), 'exec'))
